skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim silences, add captions, and export as MP4 — and get edited MP4 videos...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video AI — fast, automated cloud video editing and export for creators and students.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files up to 500MB and get quick AI edits (1-2 min typical processing).
- Describe edits in plain language (trim silences, add captions, aspect ratio changes, etc.); AI handles the rest.
- Automatic setup: connects to backend, manages authentication, and session creation.
- Exports high-quality MP4 videos ready for download.
- Supports credit checks, session status, error messages, and guided workflows through easy prompts.
